data.name: Steel Stalker
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the darkest shift of your life. Steel Stalker is a suspense-filled psychological horror experience in which a devastating cyber-attack has turned the data centre where you work into a deadly trap.

  • Every Sound Could Be Your Last: Your loyal robotic guard dog has been corrupted by a virus. It is now ruthlessly hunting you down using its highly advanced sound detection sensors. A single careless footstep will draw it straight to you. You must outwit this artificial intelligence, designed to protect you.

  • Hardware Repairs and Virus Clean-up: The cyber-attack is physically burning out the servers. Hide within the facility to locate and replace burning computer components, and initiate an antivirus clean-up on the terminal laptops.

  • Claustrophobic Tension: The facility is running on emergency generators. Sneak your way through endless server racks, illuminated only by eerie red lights and your limited torch.

  • High-Risk System Failures: Access the terminals to remove the virus, but be careful; triggering a system failure could cut off the power completely and leave you face to face with your mechanical pursuer in pitch darkness.

data.short_description: Steel Stalker is a first-person psychological thriller. A cyber-attack has brought down the data centre where you work, transforming the robotic security dog into a sound-activated, deadly hunter. Move in the dead of silence, repair damaged equipment, remove the virus and survive in the dark.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror and jump scare elements. Players are stalked by an enemy AI in dark environments. When caught, a sudden jump scare sequence triggers, which includes a shaking camera falling to the ground and a loud human scream audio. The game does absolutely NOT contain any blood, gore, sexual content, or realistic violence.
